PROMPT B — PREMIER MULTI-PAGE AUTHORITY HUB (v3 FINAL) Master prompt for a 5–8 page, 1,200+ words/page authority site with the full 108-point optimization stack. Two-pass contract. Plan-mode first, then Build-mode only after operator approval.

EXECUTION RULES Same as PROMPT A §0, with one addition: Word floor: every content page ≥ 1,200 real words, written in owner voice from /brand/resonance.json. No filler, no AI cliches ("in today's fast-paced world", "leverage", "synergy", "unlock"). Pass 1 is Plan mode only and must stop for approval before Build. Pass 2 is one complete Build pass after approval. Final Build reply format (8 lines):
Lane: [chosen lane]
Palette: [3 OKLCH + accent, sourced]
Type: [display / body, sourced]
Widget: [vertical-specific widget]
CountUps: [n1] · [n2] · [n3]
Pages: [list of 5–8 routes]
Optimization: [108 / 108]
Resonance: [1-sentence rapport line]
PHASE 0 — BRAND INTAKE + SCRAPE + RESONANCE Identical to PROMPT A §1, with this expansion:
1.6 Deep scrape (Premier tier only) Competitor scan — Firecrawl search top 5 local competitors for "{vertical} {city}" → scrape each → diff positioning language → surgically reposition where the client overlaps. GBP review mining — pull top 50 reviews → cluster praise/complaint themes → seed FAQ + objection-handler sections. Photo audit — extract owner's actual photos (job sites, team, vehicles) → use these as proof, gallery, brand texture, trust evidence, and up-to-20-percent hero inspiration unless hero_source_mode=uploaded is explicitly approved. Do not let client photos become the hero ceiling by default. Schema mining — read competitors' JSON-LD → confirm we cover every type they cover plus 3 more. Outputs identical to PROMPT A §1.5 plus /brand/competitive.json.

PHASE 1 — FLAGSHIP 3.0 CINEMATIC HERO Use PROMPT A §2 as minimum quality requirements, not a locked anatomy. Premier tier adds: Hero video or AI-composed cinematic scene is longer (12–18s vs 6–10s) and includes a second B-roll/scene layer when useful. Eyebrow row is optional and must fit the unique design fingerprint. A 4th stat counter is allowed (industry-specific, e.g. "Avg response: 28 min"). Each premier build must vary hero archetype, section geometry, motion grammar, typography pairing, CTA grammar, widget motif, gallery frame, and anti-repetition gates.
PHASE 2 — MULTI-PAGE ARCHITECTURE (5–8 PAGES) Standard set (agent adds/removes based on vertical): Home — Flagship 3.0 hero + condensed sections from §A.3 + 2 deep teases into inner pages About / Founder Story — 1,200+ words, owner voice, real timeline, real team Services hub + one page per service — each service page 1,200+ words, Q-format <h2> headings (AEO bait) Process / How It Works — 1,200+ words, numbered ribbon, real lead times Service Areas / Geo page — 1,200+ words covering primary + secondary cities, embedded map, neighborhood mentions FAQ — 20+ Q&A in owner vocabulary, FAQPage + speakable schema Contact — full form, NAP, hours, embedded map, sticky widget Optional case studies / portfolio / reviews wall — adds depth when scrape provides material
Each inner page gets: Unique title + meta description Unique OG image (auto-generated, branded) Breadcrumb schema 1 mid-page CTA strip + 1 bottom CTA 2 internal cross-links to related pages 1 outbound link to authoritative source (E-E-A-T signal)

PHASE 3 — WIDGET LIBRARY Use PROMPT A §4 rules, but make the widget business-specific, not merely vertical-specific. Premier tier may add a second lightweight widget on a different page (e.g. a Quick Quote on Home plus a Booking Slot Picker on Contact). Each widget must define the business problem, input fields, output/action, conversion trigger, and why it helps both the owner and the customer.
PHASE 4 — THE 108-POINT OPTIMIZATION STACK Every point sourced from /brand/profile.json and /brand/resonance.json — no invented data.
SEO Foundations (1–20)

<title> ≤ 60 chars w/ keyword + geo · 2. Meta desc ≤ 160 · 3. Canonical · 4. Robots meta · 5. sitemap.xml · 6. robots.txt · 7. llms.txt (AI crawlers) · 8. Single H1 per page · 9. Semantic HTML5 · 10. Descriptive alts · 11. Internal linking graph ≥ 3 links/page · 12. Outbound authoritative links · 13. Anchor-text variety · 14. URL slugs short + keyword · 15. 301 from common typos · 16. 404 page custom · 17. Pagination rel-prev/next where applicable · 18. Hreflang if multi-language · 19. og:image 1200×630 branded · 20. twitter:card summary_large_image
E-E-A-T (21–35) 21. Real founder bio · 22. Real team page · 23. Real credentials/licenses · 24. Years-in-business stat · 25. Real address · 26. Real phone with tel: · 27. Real reviews quoted · 28. Real photos · 29. Author byline on content · 30. Last-updated dates · 31. Citations to authoritative sources · 32. NAP consistency across site + schema + footer · 33. Mission statement in owner voice · 34. Awards/certifications (only real) · 35. Press mentions (only real)

Schema / JSON-LD (36–48) 36. LocalBusiness (or vertical subtype) · 37. Organization · 38. Person (founder) · 39. Service (per service page) · 40. FAQPage w/ speakable · 41. BreadcrumbList · 42. WebSite w/ SearchAction · 43. Article on case studies · 44. Review aggregate (only with real reviews) · 45. OpeningHoursSpecification · 46. GeoCoordinates · 47. ContactPoint · 48. PostalAddress

Technical / Crawl (49–60) 49. HTTPS · 50. HTTP/2 or 3 · 51. Brotli/gzip · 52. Mobile-first responsive · 53. Touch targets ≥ 44px · 54. No mixed content · 55. No render-blocking JS above fold · 56. Critical CSS inlined · 57. Async/defer on non-critical scripts · 58. Service-worker / offline fallback (premier) · 59. No orphan pages · 60. XML sitemap submitted

Core Web Vitals / Performance (61–75) 61. LCP < 2.0s · 62. INP < 200ms · 63. CLS < 0.05 · 64. TTFB < 600ms · 65. Hero image WebP/AVIF · 66. Lazy load below fold · 67. Preload hero only · 68. Preconnect to fonts/CDN · 69. Font-display: swap · 70. Image dimensions set · 71. No layout shift from late fonts · 72. Compressed video (H.264 baseline, ≤ 1.5MB) · 73. Reduced-motion respected · 74. JS budget ≤ 200KB gzipped · 75. CSS budget ≤ 80KB gzipped

Accessibility (76–85) 76. AA contrast everywhere · 77. Focus rings visible · 78. Keyboard nav complete · 79. aria-label on icon buttons · 80. Skip-to-content link · 81. Form labels + error messages · 82. Color not sole signal · 83. Captions/transcripts on video · 84. lang attr on <html> · 85. No autoplay audio

Local / GEO (86–95) 86. City + state in title/H1/footer/schema · 87. Service-area page per primary city · 88. Embedded Google Map · 89. Driving directions block · 90. Neighborhood mentions in body · 91. Local landmarks referenced · 92. NAP-consistent citation pack generated · 93. GBP description (3 lengths: 250/500/750) generated · 94. Suggested GBP categories listed · 95. Local schema areaServed

Voice / AI Search (96–104) 96. Q-format <h2> headings · 97. Conversational answer paragraphs · 98. Speakable schema on FAQ + featured answers · 99. llms.txt with site summary · 100. Concise direct answers in first paragraph of each section · 101. Long-tail question pages (FAQ each get an anchor) · 102. name and description clear in all schema · 103. Author and source citations parseable · 104. Structured tables for comparable data (parsed by AI overviews)

Conversion (105–108) 105. Tiered CTA ladder (PDF download → 20-min consult → full quote) · 106. Sticky contact bubble w/ owner photo · 107. Exit-intent modal (email gate for PDF) · 108. UTM-tagged lead capture + Slack/email notification

PHASE 5 — INFRASTRUCTURE
Identical to PROMPT A §6 plus: lead_events table (richer schema with widget payload, scroll depth, time on page) send-capabilities-pdf edge function (Tier-1 CTA) lead-autoresponder edge function (instant ack + 24h + 72h sequence) Lead scoring: domain check vs Fortune-1000.json shipped locally → subject prefix [ENTERPRISE LEAD] vs [lead] Optional Slack/Teams webhook if connector linked

PHASE 6 — SELF-QA CHECKLIST
PROMPT A §7 checklist plus: [ ] Every content page ≥ 1,200 words, written in owner voice [ ] All 108 optimization points present and sourced [ ] Competitor diff applied (no overlap with top-5 local competitors) [ ] Tiered CTA ladder live on every page [ ] Autoresponder sequence sends correctly [ ] All inner-page OG images unique and branded [ ] Speakable schema validates [ ] llms.txt published at root [ ] Local SEO pack (CSV + GMB copy + schema) written to /mnt/documents/local-seo-pack/

FINAL OUTPUT
Reply with the 8-line format from §0 after the approved Build pass. Nothing else. Ship it complete. Make it theirs. Do not treat Plan mode as permission to build.
